# Hash-pinned requirements for two CI installs, both with --require-hashes:
# the "Install zizmor" step in actionlint.yml installs the whole file, and
# the "Lint the claim script" step in tests.yml lifts the ruff block with
# awk and installs it. A version pin alone still installs whatever artifact
# the index serves for that version; these sha256 hashes make the install
# the same bytes on every run.
#
# What the hashes have to cover is the wheel each consumer's runner
# resolves: actionlint.yml's ubuntu-latest runner takes x86_64 glibc,
# CPython 3.13, and tests.yml's matrix adds macos-latest, which takes an
# arm64 macOS wheel. zizmor declares no runtime dependencies, so PyYAML is
# the whole transitive closure; ruff ships none, so its block installs
# alone.
#
# The `pip` entry in .github/dependabot.yml watches this directory, so a
# version bump arrives as a pull request with the --hash lines rewritten
# beside it, and the set it writes is every artifact the release ships
# rather than that one platform's. With `--require-hashes` that superset is
# accepted and the runner's wheel is matched out of it. If Dependabot
# cannot resolve the new version's hashes the update opens no pull request
# and the pin stays where it is, so the procedure below is the fallback.
# To regenerate the hashes for this platform by hand instead of copying
# them from a release page --
#
#   python3 -m pip download -d /tmp/req-dl zizmor==<new> PyYAML==<new>
#   sha256sum /tmp/req-dl/*
#
# then rewrite the --hash lines from that output. If a bump introduces a
# new transitive dependency, add a requirement line for it too:
# hash-checking mode still resolves dependencies and refuses any it cannot
# pin, so a dep the file omits fails the install loudly -- the sha256sum
# output above lists every artifact in the closure.
# Both consumers re-run when the file changes: actionlint.yml's push
# trigger is paths-ignore of four documentation files, which a change
# here never matches, and tests.yml's push and pull_request triggers
# are unfiltered.

zizmor==1.30.1 \
    --hash=sha256:06e039fae8e185e2a1a8b002f2d95a6f5c3b548048bdd79e004dcb501fcd0868 \
    --hash=sha256:15679642e8c4f825ba3f22537c698b1bbbad19ead23640f62ec45ebbe7abc803 \
    --hash=sha256:17fda74e15fe41a6aa354ea4cf71fc7ff3cd025cda6584bb6d7466b3f1d00fe6 \
    --hash=sha256:42512bb4a1bce4c787d221d1572ff6b691fa52a3d129b2910be8afaf860c5871 \
    --hash=sha256:4a5ef2fa4fbd2984f794cfc2f95790bd03fa0bae801487ed550e044675874e60 \
    --hash=sha256:5e8a3d54c3d9d51307371f4d1d49f8f9e56de00205c6cc660c6846a95ad4e135 \
    --hash=sha256:92906f448365672ebb657fb50d36f997290a3aaba8cac723214741ea9054845d \
    --hash=sha256:bf63099a27ef3bf1329dbab44bb9d1027124855c71bd0eca864d5c8e1c5c0db1 \
    --hash=sha256:cbb7e5cb2fec471066d5c326bcaa69ed3eefdcf6a76d7ad38335b924acf86c07 \
    --hash=sha256:eee12266b793cb87ad4a7e3af2e72404f8a63e3de5eb099b80bf7b1cfd232a8e \
    --hash=sha256:f9eb092f089e35fa9fb3b70aeec0a19eca7dacf2ab161f1d50b18351895f085c
PyYAML==6.0.3 \
    --hash=sha256:0f29edc409a6392443abf94b9cf89ce99889a1dd5376d94316ae5145dfedd5d6
